<section class="about-intro-section" id="about">
<div class="w">
<div class="about-layout">
<div class="about-copy">
<div class="eb">About me · Computer student &amp; creative</div>
<h2>Building my future, <span>one step at a time.</span></h2>
<p class="about-lead">I'm Mahnoor Ansari, a computer student, portrait artist, art teacher and aspiring developer from Karachi, Pakistan.</p>
<p>I'm learning <strong>C++</strong>, <strong>Java</strong> and <strong>Python</strong> as I build a foundation in programming. I also create websites and games using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and explore graphic design and portrait art.</p>
<p>I'm a hardworking, independent student who is supporting herself while continuing her education. Balancing my studies with creative work has taught me to stay determined, responsible and focused on my goals.</p>
<p>My biggest goal is to pursue further education in computing and earn a <strong>bachelor's degree abroad</strong>. I want to grow my technical skills, learn from new experiences and create a future I can be proud of.</p>
<div class="about-actions"><a class="b" href="#/web">See my projects</a><a class="b subtle" href="#/contact">Get in touch</a></div>
</div>
<figure class="about-portrait">
<img alt="Mahnoor Ansari — portrait for her portfolio" decoding="async" height="1410" loading="eager" src="data:image/png;base64," width="1116"/>
<figcaption><span>Mahnoor Ansari</span><small>Computer Student · Artist · Aspiring Developer</small></figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
<div aria-label="Experience and work highlights" class="stats about-stats">
<div><b>1</b>Year teaching at The Educators</div>
<div><b>2</b>Portrait-sketching certificates</div>
<div><b>24</b>Artworks in my portfolio</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section aria-labelledby="journey-title" class="my-journey-section">
<div class="w">
<div class="eb">My journey</div>
<h2 id="journey-title">Learning with purpose. <span>Dreaming bigger.</span></h2>
<p class="sub">I'm growing as both a computer student and a creative person — building practical skills while working toward a long-term academic goal.</p>
<div class="journey-grid">
<article class="journey-card"><span class="journey-number">01</span><h3>What I'm learning</h3><p>I'm a beginner in C++, Java and Python, studying programming step by step and putting my knowledge into practice.</p></article>
<article class="journey-card"><span class="journey-number">02</span><h3>How I work</h3><p>I support myself and stay committed to my studies. Independence, hard work and consistency are important parts of my journey.</p></article>
<article class="journey-card"><span class="journey-number">03</span><h3>Where I'm headed</h3><p>My ambition is to continue my education abroad, earn a bachelor's degree in my field and build a meaningful career in technology.</p></article>
</div>
<div class="about-skills">
<div class="eb">Skills &amp; interests</div>
<div aria-label="Skills and interests" class="sk"><span>HTML · CSS · JavaScript</span><span>C++ · Learning</span><span>Java · Learning</span><span>Python · Learning</span><span>Portrait drawing</span><span>Graphite</span><span>Charcoal</span><span>Pastel</span><span>Digital art</span><span>Photoshop &amp; Illustrator (taught)</span><span>CorelDRAW</span><span>Adobe Express</span><span>Teaching</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

const PROJECTS = [["stellar","Stellar Rush","project3","A full space arcade game with three modes (Survival, Time Attack, Zen Flight), score multiplier, hyperspeed dash, local leaderboard and achievements.",true],["pixel","Pixel Pit","projectgame1","A playful arcade site with a fully playable Snake game, built on a canvas game loop with keyboard and touch controls and a saved best score.",true],["iron","IRON HOUSE","projectgym","A dark, high-contrast landing page for a fictional gym, with programs, membership plans that pre-fill the contact form, and a responsive menu.",false],["paws","Paws & Claws","portfolio","A responsive landing page for a pet grooming salon, with a mobile menu, service cards and a demo appointment form.",false]];
const BASE = "https://mahn00ransari.github.io/";
const ROUTES = ["home", "about", "sketches", "digital", "web", "teaching", "contact"];
const TITLES = {home:"",about:"About | ",sketches:"Sketches | ",digital:"Digital Art | ",web:"Web | ",teaching:"Teaching | ",contact:"Contact | "};
const asset = p => (typeof INLINE_IMAGES !== "undefined" && INLINE_IMAGES[p]) || p;

function gallery(target, entries) {
  const grid = document.getElementById(target);
  if (!grid) return;
  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  entries.forEach(item => {
    const card = document.createElement("button");
    card.type="button";card.className="it";card.dataset.c=item.c;
    card.setAttribute("aria-label", "View " + item.t + " artwork");
    const image=document.createElement("img");
    image.src=asset(item.s);image.alt=item.t;image.loading="lazy";image.decoding="async";
    card.appendChild(image);
    if(item.g) {
      const tag=document.createElement("span");tag.className="tag";tag.textContent=item.g;card.appendChild(tag);
    }
    const info=document.createElement("span");info.className="meta";
    const title=document.createElement("strong");title.textContent=item.t;info.appendChild(title);
    if(item.d){const desc=document.createElement("span");desc.className="desc";desc.textContent=item.d;info.appendChild(desc);}
    card.appendChild(info);
    card.addEventListener("click",()=>openPreview(item.s,item.t));
    frag.appendChild(card);
  });
  grid.replaceChildren(frag);
}

gallery("ga",WORK.art);
gallery("gd",WORK.design);

function buildWebProjects(){
  const target=document.getElementById("gw");
  const fragment=document.createDocumentFragment();
  for(const [id,name,slug,desc,isGame] of PROJECTS){
    const card=document.createElement("article");card.className="card";
    const preview=document.createElement("button");preview.type="button";
    preview.className="fr";preview.style.display="block";preview.style.width="calc(100% - 32px)";
    preview.style.padding="0";preview.style.color="inherit";
    preview.setAttribute("aria-label","Preview "+name);
    const img=document.createElement("img");img.src=asset(`assets/images/web/${id}.jpg`);img.alt=name;img.loading="lazy";
    preview.appendChild(img);
    if(isGame){const inImg=document.createElement("img");inImg.className="in";inImg.src=asset(`assets/images/web/${id}-play.jpg`);inImg.alt=name+" gameplay";inImg.loading="lazy";preview.appendChild(inImg);}
    preview.addEventListener("click",()=>openPreview(`assets/images/web/${id}-full.jpg`,name));
    const body=document.createElement("div");body.className="cb";
    const h=document.createElement("h3");h.textContent=name;
    const stack=document.createElement("div");stack.className="st";stack.textContent="Concept project · HTML · CSS · JavaScript";
    const p=document.createElement("p");p.textContent=desc;
    const link=document.createElement("a");link.className="b";link.href=BASE+slug+"/";link.target="_blank";link.rel="noopener noreferrer";link.textContent="View live ↗";
    body.append(h,stack,p,link);card.append(preview,body);fragment.appendChild(card);
  }
  target.replaceChildren(fragment);
}
buildWebProjects();

for(const tabs of document.querySelectorAll(".tabs")){
  tabs.addEventListener("click", e=>{
    const button=e.target.closest("button[data-f]");
    if(!button||!tabs.contains(button))return;
    const f=button.dataset.f;
    tabs.querySelectorAll("button[data-f]").forEach(b=>{b.classList.toggle("on",b===button);b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",b===button?"true":"false");});
    const id=tabs.dataset.t==="art"?"ga":"gd";
    document.querySelectorAll("#"+id+" .it").forEach(card=>{card.hidden=f!=="all"&&card.dataset.c!==f;card.style.display=card.hidden?"none":"";});
  });
  tabs.querySelectorAll("button[data-f]").forEach(b=>b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",b.classList.contains("on")?"true":"false"));
}

const lightbox=document.getElementById("lb");
const lightboxImg=lightbox.querySelector("img");
let returnFocus=null;
function openPreview(path,title){
  returnFocus=document.activeElement;
  lightboxImg.src=asset(path);lightboxImg.alt=title||"Artwork preview";
  lightbox.querySelector(".caption").textContent=title||"";
  lightbox.classList.add("on");document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
  lightbox.querySelector("button").focus();
}
function closePreview(){
  lightbox.classList.remove("on");lightboxImg.removeAttribute("src");
  document.body.style.overflow="";
  if(returnFocus&&typeof returnFocus.focus==="function")returnFocus.focus();
}
lightbox.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click",closePreview);
lightbox.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===lightbox)closePreview();});
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"&&lightbox.classList.contains("on"))closePreview();});
document.querySelectorAll("[data-preview]").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>openPreview(b.dataset.preview,b.dataset.title)));

const menuButton=document.getElementById("mb"),menu=document.getElementById("mn");
menuButton.addEventListener("click",()=>{
  const expanded=menu.classList.toggle("on");
  menuButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(expanded));
});
function closeMenu(){menu.classList.remove("on");menuButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");}
menu.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target.closest("a"))closeMenu();});

document.getElementById("y").textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
function routeFromHash(){const value=decodeURIComponent(location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/,""));return ROUTES.includes(value)?value:"home";}
function renderPage(){
  const route=routeFromHash();
  for(const name of ROUTES)document.getElementById("p-"+name).classList.toggle("on",route===name);
  document.querySelectorAll("#mn a").forEach(a=>{
    const active=a.getAttribute("href")==="#/"+route;
    a.classList.toggle("on",active);
    if(active)a.setAttribute("aria-current","page");else a.removeAttribute("aria-current");
  });
  document.title=TITLES[route]+"Mahnoor Ansari | Designer. Developer. Artist.";
  closeMenu();window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
window.addEventListener("hashchange",renderPage);
renderPage();
